💲 Product Prices
Set what each type of customer pays for every product — Retail, Wholesale and Employee.
🏷️ New here? Read this first (click to hide / show)
Each product can have three prices. While billing, the cashier picks a mode and that price is charged automatically.
RetailThe normal walk-in price — this is the product's MRP. Changing it here changes the MRP.
WholesaleA lower price for bulk / shop buyers. You type the exact price — there is no automatic discount.
EmployeeA staff price. Same idea — type the exact price you want staff to pay.
⚠️ Leave Wholesale or Employee blank to block it. A product with no Wholesale price simply can't be sold in Wholesale mode until you set one. Retail (MRP) always works.
📈 Auto-WS at qty — type a quantity (e.g. 10) to make a normal Retail line switch itself to the Wholesale price automatically once the cashier rings that many of the item. Below the quantity it stays Retail. Needs a Wholesale price set. Leave blank to turn it off.
How to set a price
1  Find the product with the search box below  →  2  Type the price into the Wholesale or Employee box  →  3  Click that row's green Save.
Example: a Coffee Mug with MRP ₹100 → you set Wholesale ₹80 and Employee ₹70. Walk-in customers still pay ₹100.
